what: PDMD 4-step at full rank against FlashGen and against kijai's rank-reduced resize of the same file, the first look at PDMD (docs/research/pdmd/2026-10-01_what_pdmd_is.md). The owner's scenes, 2026-10-01: three t2va bank scenes (radio drama, stairwell dialogue, covered market), ref2va with the old man (1-man.png) in the mountain landscape (2-mountain_landscape.png), and i2va with the old man as the first frame.
why: FlashGen is PDMD's closest sibling: same objective family, a 4-step LoRA at the call, Euler at 12/3. The pair differs only in the LoRA and its schedule (PDMD on `simple`, FlashGen on its own ManualSigmas); images, prompt, checkpoint, canvas, sampler and Sol match per scene. i2va and ref2va are untrained transfers for both distills, and ref2va also runs PDMD on the Ref2VA checkpoint. Seed-matched clips from two distills are different samples (docs/h3_distills.md, the box at the top), so the owner judges blind pairs over the scenes. The kijai arm (owner, 2026-10-01: "add kijai's though - for each one") differs from the full-rank PDMD arm only in the LoRA file, so it asks whether kijai's resize shows (bench/results/2026-10-01_pdmd_4step_lora_conversion.json).

seeds.note: held: one seed per scene, the three arms differ only in the distill file

blind: blind_batch.py with one contest per scene and question, ten in all: --pairs radio_drama__pdmd,radio_drama__flashgen --pairs radio_drama__pdmd,radio_drama__pdmd_kijai --pairs stairwell_dialogue__pdmd,stairwell_dialogue__flashgen --pairs stairwell_dialogue__pdmd,stairwell_dialogue__pdmd_kijai --pairs covered_market__pdmd,covered_market__flashgen --pairs covered_market__pdmd,covered_market__pdmd_kijai --pairs ref2va_old_man_mountains__pdmd,ref2va_old_man_mountains__flashgen --pairs ref2va_old_man_mountains__pdmd,ref2va_old_man_mountains__pdmd_kijai --pairs i2va_old_man__pdmd,i2va_old_man__flashgen --pairs i2va_old_man__pdmd,i2va_old_man__pdmd_kijai. Then the lean pairs-only page (docs/eval_comparison.md, 'The lean pairs-only session'); read the aggregate over scenes by arm from by_pair.
order: per scene, PDMD, then kijai's PDMD, then FlashGen, so later arms reuse the scene's text encode. No two arms share a sampler cache: each applies a different LoRA.
next: The 2-step probe after this, if PDMD holds up.
